values.note: First-come, first-served only: arrive to claim a site. recreation.gov lists the campground for Scan and Pay on site.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158515 (Overview: 'available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site'), read 2026-10-20

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/wolf-gap-recreation-area (Seasons of Use: 'Open year round'; last updated 2025-05-02), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158515 (amenities: Vault Toilets, Fire Pit, Tent Pads, Paved Parking) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/wolf-gap-recreation-area ('Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed FCFS only (rec.gov). Added year-round season (FS page), vault toilets (rec.gov) and no potable water (FS page). Fees left alone: FS page says 'No Fee' (agreeing with the --AWH note) but recreation.gov carries a 2025 Scan and Pay walk-in rate of $10/$20 (see flags). Not stated: site count, lengths.
flags: Fees conflict, not written: the --AWH note and the FS page (last updated 2025-05-02) say no fee, but recreation.gov facility 10158515 has a 'First-come, First-served Season' 2025-01-01..2025-12-31, effective 2025-07-15, with Scan and Pay rates ScanPay 1 $10 and ScanPay 2 $20 (STANDARD NONELECTRIC). No 2026 rate season is listed. Wolf Gap may now charge $10/night; a human should check (an on-site fee board would settle it).
